motiveMeaning: A reason prompting any Entity actor toward action or omission; conscious intention is not required.
actorModel: any eventcore:Entity through an actor RoleBinding reached by an outgoing edge from the selected view, or unresolved

consequence.origin: Distinguish own record change from hypothesized downstream effect change; each exact Delta belongs only to its own record.

constraints: One motive and one selected view per hypothesis.

Selected actor role, when present, is reached by interpretationBindsRole or candidateBindsRole from the selected hypothesisView and named actor; derive Entity through roleBoundEntity. Other views may reference the same RoleBinding.
Episode/action/registered record states derive through the selected view; do not duplicate or overwrite them.
Source speaker, support author and motivated actor are distinct roles.
Keep positive and negative declared support independent; absent links do not assert absence of motive.
Known prompting and target records must be distinct, with explicit scope/time/clock alignment for an ordered causal claim.
A motive does not establish action performance, omission duty/capability/deadline/exception, consciousness, fault or sanction.
Review is proposal workflow only; future consumers must explicitly validate cross-node bindings.

For downstream consequences match the exact selected cause view, retain each CausalHypothesis identity/state and follow its effect view to the separate effect record; a shared record or actor is not the same cause view.
For the pilot omission scope use its own record plus a CausalHypothesis; do not select the movement record simply to obtain a nonempty own Delta.
An effect change can be structurally checked while attribution to the omission remains hypothesized; an empty own Delta does not deny downstream effects.
